title: Real RK3588 Rocket FDIV decision table and candidate RTL contract
scope: Real RK3588 Rocket DPU EW FDIV captures; not an RK silicon specification and not FPGA/RTL evidence.
constraints_honoured: No ssh/scp/192.168.192.18 access by this analysis.
No RTL, test, doc or family bundle was modified.
Nothing was committed, programmed or flashed.

provenance.device_access: none by this analysis; captures were produced by earlier board runs

real-rocket-fdiv8.scope: real RK3588 Rocket DPU EW FDIV; not a silicon specification

real-rocket-fdiv8-special.scope: real RK3588 Rocket DPU EW FDIV 24-lane special-value capture on /dev/accel/accel0; not a silicon specification

real-rocket-fdiv8-finite-sweep.scope: real RK3588 Rocket DPU EW FDIV 32-lane finite/rounding sweep on /dev/accel/accel0; not a silicon specification

run.lock: flock -x -w 900, one invocation for all 8 cases

fdiv-systematic.note: Real 8-case, 256-lane device capture; no oracle. Every lane is now observed. The grid settles the special-value rules; it does not replace the 1024-lane A/7 finite-rounding evidence.

oracle_reference.finding: 32-lane finite sweep and 11 finite special lanes match exact binary16 RNE, including eight exact subnormal ties; the ew-fp16 A/7-like p1 cases are one FP16 ULP low.

observed_directly: 256-lane class grid: 8/8 cases submit_ret=0, 512 output bytes, every lane read back.
Special-path result sign is sign(a), not sign(a)^sign(b): divide-by-zero, inf numerator, inf divisor -> zero, zero numerator -> zero.
NaN precedence is total: qNaN or sNaN on either side -> 0x7c01 for all 60 NaN-containing grid cells.
Finite-path sign is sign(a)^sign(b), including finite overflow (+/-inf) and finite underflow (+/-0).
Finite division is exact RNE except in one false-tie window; 1278/1278 finite nonzero lanes match the 3-guard-bit model.
100/100 finite-finite class pairs match both exact RNE and the 3-guard-bit model; the single window lane overflows and is unobservable.
19 unique A/7 operands in p1_n1024 (20 lane records with the n33 repeat) are exactly 1 ULP low.
Eight exact destination-ulp ties in the older captures round to even (including zero and subnormal results).
max/min_norm and 1/min_sub overflow to +inf; min_sub/max underflows to +0; grid confirms gross overflow/underflow signs.
inferred_not_observed: The finite rounding rule is modelled as: truncate the exact quotient to 3 bits below the final destination ulp, then round to nearest with ties-to-even on the truncated 11-bit significand (no sticky bit).
The quasi-tie behaviour is caused by the missing sticky bit, not by global truncation: 183/1196 older-capture lanes would differ under truncation and 20 differ under exact RNE.
The special-case sign(a) rule is directly observed for all 16 classes on both sides; the internal mechanism (numerator sign register vs XOR bypass) is inferred.
The sign of a NaN result is always positive 0x7c01 in the grid; negative-NaN input is not represented in the 16-class set.
Subnormal-result rounding at the final 2^-24 quantum is inferred from two exact subnormal ties and two inexact subnormal results.
Overflow-to-infinity at the IEEE-like threshold is inferred from the rounding rule; only gross overflow is captured.
unknown_needs_more_device_data: Negative NaN operands (0xfe00, 0xfc01, ...) and sNaN payloads other than 0x7c01; the grid's sNaN is 0x7c01, which is also the canonical output, so payload pass-through vs canonicalization is not distinguished.
Negative subnormal classes (0x8001, 0x83ff, ...) as class representatives; only 0x8001/0x8003 appear in the finite sweep.
Subnormal results with a fractional part in the 0.5 < f < 0.625 window; no such lane exists in any capture.
A negative-result false tie in the window; all 19 observed anomalies are positive.
Rounding exactly at the overflow boundary (max finite vs infinity, including the 65520 tie) and at the minimum-subnormal boundary (2^-25, 2^-24).
Anything observed through the FP16 output converter with a non-unity scale (out_convert != 1).
Behaviour at other widths/lane counts and with linked PC chains.
Latency, throughput and IEEE exception flags; none are encoded in the captures.

rounding_model.status: candidate; 0 mismatches on 1278 finite nonzero device lanes
rounding_model.summary: Exact rational |a|/|b|; final binary16 quantum u = 2^max(e-10,-24); n = floor(Q/u); m = floor(8*frac(Q/u)); round up iff m>4 or (m==4 and n odd); finite-path sign = sa^sb.
rounding_model.equivalent_view: Quotient delivered with 11 significand bits plus 3 guard bits, truncated (no sticky), then round-to-nearest ties-to-even.

false_tie_window.effect: device returns n (one ULP below exact RNE)
false_tie_window.observed: 19 unique operand pairs, all B=7, A=18+56k pattern subset; 20 lane records including the n33 repeat
false_tie_window.why: first three fraction bits are 100; truncation turns a non-tie into an exact half and ties-to-even rounds the even n down
false_tie_window.grid_note: The 256-pair grid has one window lane (fin_max/sub_max) but it is an overflow lane: exact RNE and the 3-bit rule both return +inf, so it is unobservable.

coverage.normal_range: supported by the sweep, fdiv8, p1/p2 and 100 finite-finite grid pairs
coverage.subnormal_results: 8 nonzero subnormal results in the older captures plus 16 true subnormal grid results (and 2 grid min-normal results); six n>0 ties, six zero-result ties
coverage.normal_range_true_ties: none captured; only subnormal/zero exact ties exist

a_over_7_subsequence.description: B=7.0 only when lane index i % 8 == 1; A = i+1 = 2,10,18,...,1018
a_over_7_subsequence.anomaly_condition: 0.5 < fraction_in_ulp < 0.625 AND truncated 11-bit significand n is even

quirks.note: canonical NaN is the sNaN encoding 0x7c01; this is the only zero/zero NaN
all other zero/zero pairs return signed infinity with sign(a)
no invalid operation; result is signed infinity with sign(a)

quirks.inputs: divide-by-zero, inf numerator, inf divisor, zero numerator
quirks.note: all special-path results take the numerator sign; finite results take sign xor

quirks.inputs: qnan and snan on either side
quirks.note: payload and sign are dropped; quiet bit is clear; sNaN is not distinguished
3-guard-bit truncation creates a false tie; ties-to-even can round down
contrast with Q4: the finite datapath uses xor even when the result is inf or zero
